story.title: Our Love Story
story.subtitle: From serendipitous beginnings to a lifetime of love and discovery
paragraphs: It all started on a crisp autumn evening at a quiet cafe. What began as an hour-long conversation effortlessly stretched into midnight walks under amber street lamps, filled with shared laughter, dreams of foreign travels, and an unmistakable sense that we had found home in one another.
Over four beautiful years of journeys—celebrating life's quiet milestones together—every memory has brought us closer.
Now, with immense joy and gratitude, we invite you to join us at Baptist Church Sanathnagar to witness and celebrate our sacred vows.
